messages:
Maia (CS): FYI - migration last night caused an indexing backlog for a subset of onboarding tenants. we’ve flagged 15 tenants; activations blocked for ~10. need customer notice + RCA cadence.
Ravi (CS): who are the highest-touch accounts so we can prioritize outreach?
Maia (CS): flagged: Acme, BrightRoom, StudyAI, ClearEdu. full list in the ticket.
Leo (Eng): root cause is a dedupe shard rebalance that created a persistent write queue and exponential retry storms. applied a hotfix at 03:24 UTC to bypass the heavy dedupe pass for pending writes.
Leo (Eng): hotfix increased throughput; reindexing rate ~650 docs/min for priority tenants. ETA ~60-120m depending on queue size.
Tess (Product): comms proposal: (A) immediate short status email with ETA + who to contact, (B) invite to an enablement office hour for technical Q&A, (C) follow-up RCA and preventive timeline. include a small credit offer.
Maia (CS): draft status: "We experienced delayed document ingestion following a migration. Engineers applied a mitigation and reindexing is in progress; priority tenants should catch up within ~2 hours. We will share a full RCA and host an office hour for impacted teams."
Ravi (CS): add 'how to reach us' + incident page link + note about a one-time 2-day credit.
Leo (Eng): long-term fixes: rate-limit dedupe windows during migrations, per-tenant queue isolation, and better retry caps. I'll author infra section for the RCA.
ops-bot: Hotfix v2026.6.14 applied to prod at 1708499800. CI checks passed. :white_check_mark:
Maia (CS): sending status email in 5m. Ravi please own replies for Acme + BrightRoom.
Ravi (CS): taking Acme. pinging BrightRoom tech lead now.
Tess (Product): scheduling office hour 11:00 UTC today; will include feedback poll and session recording.
Maia (CS): after office hour we'll consolidate feedback into the RCA and publish timeline. tagging @Leo for post-mortem, @Tess for customer timeline, @Ravi for comms log.
Maia (CS): posting the external email template here after send for reference.
